touches.text: rehearsal: the cheapest model reads a ticket cold and tries to build it on paper, saying where it got stopped or what is missing.
PURPOSE: training data, so graph trees learn to judge "buildable as written" without an LLM call.

The read is handed the plan steps, the frame (intention, why, falsifier), and what exists and what does not, measured before the read. "Cold" means no conversation, history, chart or process, not blind to the disk.
